item.title: Jeanne Findlater, first woman to lead a major market TV station in the US, reflects on career
item.description: Jeanne Findlater became vice president and general manager of WXYZ-TV in 1979, making history as the first woman in the U.S. to lead a TV station in the top 10 markets — Detroit was No. 7.

item.title: 4 dead in Michigan as powerful storms that produced at least 1 tornado rip through the state
item.description: Four people were killed Friday in southern Michigan as powerful storms that produced at least one tornado reduced homes to rubble, sent parts of roofs flying into the air and left a trail of debris.

item.title: Matthew Tkachuk has hat trick, Panthers beat Red Wings to end 4-game losing streak
item.description: Matthew Tkachuk had his sixth career hat trick and the Florida Panthers beat the Detroit Red Wings on Friday night to snap a four-game losing streak.
